carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible along the upper two-thirds of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance upper edges to shadowed lower margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 5 to 7 low-contrast, high-luminance blobs localized within the anterior-medial macro-mask of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two slender, elongated, low-reflectance silhouettes (commensal organisms) positioned ventral to the main torso, posterior to the pectoral fin.
